title: Adventures of the Falcon
overview: Undercover US government agent Michael Waring is known as The Falcon.He travels all around America – and the world – righting wrongs, helping the needy and oppressed and bringing bad guys (including gangsters, criminals, ex-Nazis and, quite often, Communists) to justice.

episodes.title: The Guilty Stamps
episodes.overview: Waring is assigned to track down a man who was supposed to purchase rare stamps for his boss but instead bought counterfeits for a fraction of his employer's money and pocketed the difference.
